tasks.task: Translate and adapt a web page for one market

items.when: Before a word is translated, to fix the reader, country, tone and what must not change
When the brief is agreed and the page must read as if written in that country
When a line has two fair readings, to get a second natural version to compare
When the client has a voice guide, to rank where the translation drifts from it
Before the page goes live, to check dates, prices, units and forms for that country

tasks.task: Make an SRT or WebVTT caption file from a recording

items.when: When there is only audio or video and you need the words written out first
When you need word-level timing and speaker labels to cut captions from
When you have a transcript and need a valid caption file with sound line breaks and timing
When timings need nudging by hand against the video
Before delivery, to catch a speaker or product name spelt two ways across the file

tasks.task: Clean up auto-captions and fix the names

items.when: When the auto-captions sit on YouTube and you need them out as clean text
When auto-captions have wrong names, no punctuation and lines that break mid-phrase
When the auto-captions are too poor to fix, to get a fresh transcript with speakers named
After the clean-up, to list any name or term still spelt more than one way

tasks.task: Translate subtitles and keep the timings

items.when: When a finished caption file must be translated line by line with every time code kept
When a line is too long to read in its slot, to get a shorter natural wording
When the client wants dubbed audio as well as subtitles for each language
When you need to watch the translated subtitles play over the video in a browser

tasks.task: Post-edit machine translation to an agreed level

items.when: Before the engine runs, to decide which texts are safe to machine translate at all
When machine output exists and must be edited to light or full level with the glossary
When machine output is poor, to compare a fresh translation in quick or reviewed mode
When the job is in Russian, English and Brazilian Portuguese, to flag changed facts and names

tasks.task: Build a bilingual glossary and style sheet

items.when: When you must harvest the client's own product phrases from a manual or page first
When the client uses several words for one thing and must pick the source term
When there is no voice guide, to build one from the client's documents before the style sheet
When source terms are settled and you need the glossary, do-not-translate list and style sheet
When the source is English, to find term clashes before they are copied into the glossary

tasks.task: Localise product listings for another country

items.when: Before translating titles, to find the words local shoppers really search for
When listings must be adapted with local terms, sizes and spelling, not word for word
Before the listings go live, to check prices, units, sizes and returns wording
Before listings go live abroad, to confirm the link, price and currency work for a buyer in that country

tasks.task: Translate app and website interface strings

items.when: When the app still has hardcoded text and no locale files to translate yet
When you get a strings file with tags, variables and length limits that must survive
After translating, to prove the JSON or CSV file still opens and saves cleanly
When strings are translated, to check meaning in context and list screens to review
When plurals, dates or right-to-left layout break in the new language

tasks.task: Adapt a voiceover script into a second language

items.when: When a video script must fit the original timing in a second language for a voice
When the client wants to hear a dubbed draft that keeps each speaker's own voice
When you need to hear the adapted script spoken to time it against the video
When the target language is English, to fix lines that trip when spoken
When the final voice is a text-to-speech voice, not a voice actor

tasks.task: Get a website ready for a new language market

items.when: When the client has not yet chosen the country, to weigh markets and what each needs
When the country is chosen and the site or shop must be made ready in its language
When the site needs language URLs, language tags, currencies and layout planned
When the shop is on Shopify and needs market groups, currency and language settings
Before launch day, to check each page type against the new country's formats

tasks.task: Check translated content before it goes live abroad

items.when: When a translated page, listing, email or screen is ready, to check formats and market fit
When images, names or examples may exclude or offend readers in the new market
When the page makes an offer or claim that may be ruled on differently in that country

tasks.task: Sort a mixed batch into machine, human and expert work

items.when: When a batch arrives with no brief, to get purpose, reader and deadline for each part
When the batch mixes blog posts, contracts and safety text and each needs its own route
When you are unsure a document is regulated and should go to a qualified human

tasks.task: Translate emails and help articles

items.when: When emails or help pages must keep links, steps and buttons right in the new language
When an article is long, to compare a quick pass with a reviewed pass before choosing
When a subject line or call to action reads stiff, to get another natural wording
Before sending, to check greetings, dates, prices and opt-out wording for that country

tasks.task: Adapt a slogan, headline or ad for a new culture

items.when: Before adapting, to pin down what the line must make people feel and do
When wordplay will not survive and the line must be rebuilt in the new language
When the literal headline falls flat, to get five fresh angles to adapt from
When you have a candidate line, to score it and see four rewrites
When a joke, colour or symbol may mean something else in the new market
When several adapted lines are ready, so a reader who has not seen your reasons picks one

tasks.task: Prepare source text so it translates cleanly

items.when: When the English source is full of idioms and long sentences an engine will mangle
When a vague source phrase hides its meaning and no translation can be right until it is clear
Before translation starts, to list typos, term clashes and jargon in the source

tasks.task: Translate a customer message and draft the reply

items.when: When a customer writes in another language and the team needs the meaning and a reply draft
When the pair is Spanish and English and you want a version with local words and notes
When the reply's facts are right but the tone is too stiff or too casual for the customer

tasks.task: Write burned-in caption text for short videos

items.when: When you need the timed transcript the on-screen words will be cut from
When the captions must be timed and set in the client's own font
When you want on-screen words that add to the speech, placed clear of the app's buttons
When the client will burn the captions in themselves on a phone
When the video is an ad, to check the cut and captions before it runs

tasks.task: Keep translated pages in step with the source each month

items.when: Monthly or at each release, for a business that already publishes in several languages
When new product terms appeared this month and the glossary must be updated first
When the set is Russian, English and Brazilian Portuguese, to find drift between versions

tasks.task: Make a transcript and show notes from a long recording

items.when: When a podcast or lesson needs the words written out with each speaker named
When the raw transcript must become a readable page with headings and no words changed
When the episode also needs a title, summary, key points and links
When recordings are private and must be transcribed on the client's own computer
Before publishing, to catch names and terms the transcriber heard two ways

tasks.task: Write alt text for images in each language

items.when: When a shop's images need alt text drafted and file names checked before translation
When the owner agrees to alt text being set on the live store's product images
When the alt text exists in one language and each market needs its own

always.when: When a translated line states a number, award or claim that differs from the source

helpers.when: When the new market needs keyword research and language tags, not only translated pages
When captions must be burned in, re-timed to a new cut or exported for each platform
When the shop's markets, currencies and language settings must be changed in the store
When hardcoded text, plurals or locale files in the app's code block the translation
When the job needs audio description or captions checked against access rules
When the market needs new product copy written for it, not an adapted version

gaps: The library is thin for translation: fewer than 50 items fit, and most captioning and localisation work rests on the kit alone
No library item checks a translation against its source line by line for omissions, numbers, names and tags
No library item post-edits machine translation or scores engine output; only the kit covers it
No library item builds a bilingual glossary or a do-not-translate list, or prepares one for a translation engine
No library item checks a caption file for reading speed, line length, overlaps and valid SRT or WebVTT format
No library item translates subtitles while keeping time codes, or adds sound labels for deaf viewers
No library item gives three transcreated options for a slogan with a back-translation and a reason for each
No library item checks dates, currency, addresses, units and forms for a locale; only the kit's prompt does
No library item checks placeholders, tags and plural forms in a strings file after translation
No library item finds which translated pages went stale after the source changed
No library item writes audio description for video, or alt text outside shop product images
No tool guide covers a translation engine or a translation memory tool, and no thinking lens is built on a translator
Language-pair help is patchy: one Spanish and English agent and a three-language parity check, nothing for other pairs
No English library item localises a listing's images, sizes and required labels for another country; the one that exists is written in Chinese
